data.one_liner: Provides a large set of predefined Color constants and Material 3 theming utilities for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The package defines a MaterialColors class with around 140 static Color constants covering many shades. It also adds Material 3 light and dark seed‑based themes and semantic color extensions. Developers can reference colors directly without additional setup.
use_when: You need quick access to a wide variety of predefined colors.
You want built‑in Material 3 seed‑based light and dark themes.
You prefer a zero‑dependency, compile‑time solution for color constants.
avoid_when: You require dynamic or runtime color generation beyond the provided palette.
You need advanced theming features like color blending or user‑customizable palettes.
Package size or minimalism is a priority over having many colors.
strengths: Simple static API – just import and use
Includes Material 3 seed‑based themes and semantic extensions
weaknesses: Only static colors – no runtime generation
Limited theming flexibility beyond provided themes
